items.value: Plant support poles can be combined into three sizes, 12 inches for a standalone plant support pole, two sections combined for a 24 inches tall plant support pole, and three sections combined for a 36 inches tall plant support pole. items.label: Sturdy & Durable Plant Stakes
items.value: All plants stakes for gardening are made of 4 mm thicken premium steel wire, plant support stakes with powder coating process on the surface, anti-rust, not easy to bend and fade, weather-resistant, sturdy materials can be used for more years than bamboo plant stakes. Compared to wood and plastic stakes, our powder coating metal green plant support are standing firmly, durable and reusable, well support for single-stemmed tomato plants.

items.label: Multifunctional Plant support
items.value: Different length plant stakes support can be applied to most single stem flowers and plants. items.label: Smart Structure Garden Stakes
items.value: You will receive 6 Group 36 inch garden stakes and 1 roll 3 ft plant ties, each group outdoor plant stakes include 1 pcs plant stakes, 2pcs extension rods, one extension rod is 12.5 inches long, and the other is 11.8 inches. The open slot of our garden stakes is designed for putting the stem plant in without hurting the plant, and the 0.8 inches inner diameter is large enough for most small single stem plants stems and vines to pass through.

items.label: Helps plants grow vertically
items.value: The single stem plant stakes and supports can be effectively prop up stem plant to grow straightly and healthily, prevent stems from bending and entangling with each other, plant stakes for outdoor plants protect tall flimsy stem plant against strong wind, heavy rain or their own heavy bloom, also help add aesthetic appeal.
